build_SEANetEncoder: build a SEANet encoder model to encode audio waveforms into latent representations with configurable downsampling ratios
build_SEANetDecoder: build a SEANet decoder model to decode latent representations back into audio waveforms with configurable upsampling ratios
build_SEANetResnetBlock: build a SEANet residual block with configurable kernel sizes, dilations, and optional true skip connections
review_SEANetEncoder_ratios: review the SEANetEncoder ratios parameter to understand how downsampling order is reversed from the decoder order
review_SEANetDecoder_final_activation: review the SEANetDecoder final_activation parameter to configure an optional output activation like tanh
